Booking terms

These are the terms for bookings with Puerto Plata Cruise Excursions. If anything is unclear, message us on WhatsApp at +1 (829) 627-7733 or email popcruiseexcursions@gmail.com before you pay.

How to book

Send us your booking on WhatsApp or by email from the form. We confirm availability, the meeting point and the time on WhatsApp or by email. Catamarans and yachts depend on the boat’s availability: message us first and pay the deposit only once we confirm.

Prices

Prices are in US dollars (US$). On the excursions, the price per person depends on how many travel together: 1 to 2, 3 to 5, 6 to 14 or 15 to 50 people. Buggies and ATVs are priced per vehicle. Catamarans and yachts are rented whole for a fixed price for up to 15 or 20 people, depending on the boat, and each extra person pays an extra fee. The price the form shows is an estimate until we confirm your booking.

Transport

The excursions include round-trip transport from the port where your cruise docks, Amber Cove or Taíno Bay. On catamarans and yachts, transport to Sosúa beach is optional and priced by group size.

Deposit and payment

Your booking is secured with a deposit by PayPal, Zelle or Cash App: 50% of the total on the excursions and a fixed amount on catamarans and yachts (shown on each boat’s card). The rest is paid in person on the day of the tour. On the excursions you can also pay the full price in advance.

Cancellation and refunds

If you cancel 10 or more days ahead, we refund 100% of what you paid; with less than 10 days, 50%. If your cruise ship doesn’t reach Puerto Plata, we refund 90%. To cancel, message us on WhatsApp or by email.

Timing and your ship

We plan each tour around your ship’s departure time. When you book, tell us your ship’s name and your all-aboard time.

Last updated: November 22, 2026.
